short_description: As a fearless dwarf delver, explore ancient ruins, uncover hidden treasures, and solve riddles. Use items and potions to outsmart monsters & environmental hazards in this stealthy non-combat adventure. Venture into the deeps in search of luck and fortune. Will you succeed?
